requirements.summary: Update the exported site-wide Facebook profile URL constant so the footer Facebook icon links to the new profile.
acceptanceCriteria: The Facebook icon link rendered in the footer uses the updated `FACEBOOK_URL` and opens the link in a new tab (target="_blank") without being treated as an invalid/disabled placeholder.

file_operations.description: Replace the existing `FACEBOOK_URL` value with `https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61587955444489&name=xhp_nt__fb__action__open_user`, leaving `LINKEDIN_URL` and `TWITTER_URL` unchanged.
